# Morning tea

The street was quiet when I opened the kitchen window. A sparrow settled on the fence.

I set two mugs beside the kettle. I checked the kitchen clock.

The doorbell rang. My neighbour had arrived for tea.

We sat at the kitchen table and planned a walk to the library.
